title: Second projection of tower comparison
statement: For abelian A, a category B, T : A ⥤ A, π : T ⟶ 𝟭 A, F : B ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ, N ∈ ℤ, b ∈ B and i ≤ N, the explicitly constructed canonicalComparison [def-tower-canonical-comparison-g3], followed by π, the second pointwise pullback projection and the inclusion of ker((differential T π F N (i+1)).app b), equals (differential T π F N i).app b. This is a property of the canonical comparison, not of arbitrary isomorphisms preserving one projection.

proof.text: Identify indexedStage i with step(indexedStage(i+1)), handling i=N with the initial zero stage and i<N with depth N i = depth N (i+1)+1. Transporting the differential across the proved current-family equality gives π followed by the functor-category second projection and kernel inclusion. Evaluate that equation. The canonical pullback comparison has second projection equal to the evaluated projection followed by the canonical kernel comparison; kernelComparison_comp_ι cancels that kernel comparison against its inclusion. Naturality of π for this specific pullback isomorphism gives the required equation for canonicalComparison.

proof_origin.place: Y5 retirement: the adopted upstream module contains the identical canonical construction and projection proofs.

lean.statement: theorem tower_comparison_second {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] (T : A ⥤ A) (π : T ⟶ 𝟭 A) (F : B ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ) (N : ℤ) (b : B) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ N) : (canonicalComparison T π F N b i hi).hom ≫ π.app _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ ≫ kernel.ι ((differential T π F N (i + 1)).app b) = (differential T π F N i).app b
